Blockchain technology works like a digital record book that is shared across many computers rather than stored in one central location. This setup makes it very secure and transparent. Each page, or "block," holds a group of transactions. Once these transactions are checked and added, they cannot be changed or erased. This is because each block is cryptographically linked to the one before it, creating a chain that is extremely difficult to tamper with or fraudulently alter.
